"lift" = metres above the floor. A piece with "parent" sits in that piece's local frame: "local" = [x, bottom height, z] in metres (glTF axes: x across, z = front direction = foot of the bed), rot_deg relative to the parent. "kind": "bedding" is drawn parametrically (duvet + pillow(s) sized from dims_mm, colours from "colors").
